sources.title: Microsoft MS-DOS Programmer's Reference (1991, Internet Archive text scan)

entries.name: dos_terminate
entries.summary: DOS INT 20h terminates the current program using the PSP segment in CS.

entries.name: dos_int21
entries.summary: DOS INT 21h is the primary MS-DOS function dispatcher; AH selects the service.

entries.name: dos_read_char_echo
entries.summary: DOS INT 21h AH=01h reads a character from standard input and echoes it to standard output.

entries.name: dos_write_char
entries.summary: DOS INT 21h AH=02h writes the character in DL to standard output.

entries.name: dos_direct_console_io
entries.summary: DOS INT 21h AH=06h performs direct console input or output depending on DL.

entries.name: dos_read_char_no_echo
entries.summary: DOS INT 21h AH=07h reads one character from standard input without echo.

entries.name: dos_read_console_char
entries.summary: DOS INT 21h AH=08h reads one console character without echo and with Ctrl-C checking.

entries.name: dos_print_string
entries.summary: DOS INT 21h AH=09h prints the '$'-terminated string pointed to by DS:DX.

entries.name: dos_buffered_input
entries.summary: DOS INT 21h AH=0Ah reads a buffered keyboard line into the buffer at DS:DX.

entries.name: dos_check_stdin_status
entries.summary: DOS INT 21h AH=0Bh checks whether a character is waiting on standard input.

entries.name: dos_flush_stdin
entries.summary: DOS INT 21h AH=0Ch flushes the keyboard buffer and then performs the input function selected by AL.

entries.name: dos_set_interrupt_vector
entries.summary: DOS INT 21h AH=25h installs a new interrupt vector using AL as the vector number and DS:DX as the handler address.

entries.name: dos_set_dta
entries.summary: DOS INT 21h AH=1Ah sets the Disk Transfer Area address from DS:DX.

entries.name: dos_get_date
entries.summary: DOS INT 21h AH=2Ah returns the current system date.

entries.name: dos_get_time
entries.summary: DOS INT 21h AH=2Ch returns the current system time.

entries.name: dos_get_version
entries.summary: DOS INT 21h AH=30h returns the DOS version number and OEM identifier.

entries.name: dos_stay_resident
entries.summary: DOS INT 21h AH=31h terminates and stays resident, keeping part of the program in memory.

entries.name: dos_get_interrupt_vector
entries.summary: DOS INT 21h AH=35h returns an interrupt vector in ES:BX for the vector number in AL.

entries.name: dos_make_directory
entries.summary: DOS INT 21h AH=39h creates the directory whose path is at DS:DX.

entries.name: dos_remove_directory
entries.summary: DOS INT 21h AH=3Ah removes the directory whose path is at DS:DX.

entries.name: dos_change_directory
entries.summary: DOS INT 21h AH=3Bh changes the current directory to the path at DS:DX.

entries.name: dos_create_file
entries.summary: DOS INT 21h AH=3Ch creates or truncates a file using the path at DS:DX and attributes in CX.

entries.name: dos_open_file
entries.summary: DOS INT 21h AH=3Dh opens an existing file using the access mode in AL and path at DS:DX.

entries.name: dos_close_file
entries.summary: DOS INT 21h AH=3Eh closes the file handle in BX.

entries.name: dos_read_file
entries.summary: DOS INT 21h AH=3Fh reads CX bytes from file handle BX into the buffer at DS:DX.

entries.name: dos_write_file
entries.summary: DOS INT 21h AH=40h writes CX bytes from DS:DX to the file handle in BX.

entries.name: dos_delete_file
entries.summary: DOS INT 21h AH=41h deletes the file whose path is at DS:DX.

entries.name: dos_seek_file
entries.summary: DOS INT 21h AH=42h moves the file pointer for handle BX according to AL and CX:DX.

entries.name: dos_file_attributes
entries.summary: DOS INT 21h AH=43h gets or sets file attributes for the path at DS:DX.

entries.name: dos_ioctl
entries.summary: DOS INT 21h AH=44h performs IOCTL device or file control functions.

entries.name: dos_get_current_directory
entries.summary: DOS INT 21h AH=47h returns the current directory for drive DL into the buffer at DS:SI.

entries.name: dos_allocate_memory
entries.summary: DOS INT 21h AH=48h allocates BX paragraphs of memory and returns the segment on success.

entries.name: dos_free_memory
entries.summary: DOS INT 21h AH=49h frees the memory block whose segment is in ES.

entries.name: dos_resize_memory
entries.summary: DOS INT 21h AH=4Ah resizes the memory block at ES to BX paragraphs.

entries.name: dos_exec
entries.summary: DOS INT 21h AH=4Bh loads or executes another program using the path at DS:DX and parameter block at ES:BX.

entries.name: dos_exit
entries.summary: DOS INT 21h AH=4Ch terminates the program and returns AL as the exit code.

entries.name: dos_get_return_code
entries.summary: DOS INT 21h AH=4Dh returns the termination type and return code of the last child process.

entries.name: dos_find_first
entries.summary: DOS INT 21h AH=4Eh begins a file search using the pattern at DS:DX and attributes in CX.

entries.name: dos_find_next
entries.summary: DOS INT 21h AH=4Fh continues the previous file search using the current DTA.

entries.name: dos_rename_file
entries.summary: DOS INT 21h AH=56h renames or moves a file from DS:DX to ES:DI.

entries.name: bios_set_video_mode
entries.summary: BIOS INT 10h AH=00h sets the current video mode using AL.

entries.name: bios_set_cursor_shape
entries.summary: BIOS INT 10h AH=01h sets the text-mode cursor start and end scan lines from CH and CL.

entries.name: bios_set_cursor_position
entries.summary: BIOS INT 10h AH=02h positions the text cursor using BH, DH, and DL.

entries.name: bios_scroll_up_window
entries.summary: BIOS INT 10h AH=06h scrolls or clears a text window defined by CX and DX.

entries.name: bios_write_char_attr
entries.summary: BIOS INT 10h AH=09h writes a character with an attribute at the cursor position.

entries.name: bios_teletype_output
entries.summary: BIOS INT 10h AH=0Eh writes one teletype character from AL and advances the cursor.

entries.name: bios_get_video_state
entries.summary: BIOS INT 10h AH=0Fh returns the current video mode, page, and text width.

entries.name: bios_read_key
entries.summary: BIOS INT 16h AH=00h waits for a keypress and returns ASCII in AL and scan code in AH.

entries.name: bios_peek_key
entries.summary: BIOS INT 16h AH=01h checks whether a key is available without removing it from the keyboard buffer.

entries.name: bios_get_shift_flags
entries.summary: BIOS INT 16h AH=02h returns the current keyboard shift-state flags in AL.
